description: Welcome to the Nick app, home of all things Nickelodeon for Windows 8! Watch short & funny original videos featuring your favorite stars and animated characters, play tons of games, check out photos of Nick stars, and more. (Please note: Full episodes are not currently available) The whole Nick gang is waiting for you ?? Victorious, SpongeBob, iCarly, Fairly Odd Parents, Big Time Rush, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Marvin Marvin, Korra, Robot & Monster, and more. Download now - let's play!
